python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from collections import Counter
cs=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')];rs=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
for i in range(51,len(cs)):
 r=dict(card_id=cs[i]['card_id'],letters='y',marks='na' if i==52 else 'y',crop_ok='y',errors=[],detail='',owner_crop=dict(one_central_line='no',text_ne_visible_line='no',other_complete_line='no',gt2_whole_neighbour_words='no',turned_or_clipped='no'),where=[],segmentation_detail='')
 if i==51:r.update(crop_ok='n',errors=['crop_overrun'],segmentation_detail='The lower bodies of words in the preceding line are visible at the upper edge; these neighbouring words are cut, not wholly visible.')
 rs.append(r)
for i in [39,47]:
 rs[i]['crop_ok']='n';rs[i]['errors'].append('crop_overrun');rs[i]['segmentation_detail']='Partial letter bodies from the preceding line appear along the upper edge; no complete neighbouring words.'
r=rs[48];r.update(letters='u',crop_ok='n',errors=['crop_clipped'],segmentation_detail='The vertically rotated number is clipped along the right edge through its digit bodies.');r['owner_crop']['text_ne_visible_line']='yes'
rs[6]['detail']='instrumenti (long s) → inftrumenti';rs[6]['where']=[{'label':'f','printed':'s'}]
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for r in rs:f.write(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(rs)==len(cs)
assert [r['card_id'] for r in rs]==[c['card_id'] for c in cs]
for r in rs:
 assert set(['card_id','letters','marks','crop_ok','errors','detail','owner_crop','where']).issubset(r)
 assert all(v in ['yes','no','uncertain'] for v in r['owner_crop'].values())
print('Count and order verified:',len(rs))
for k in ['letters','marks','crop_ok']:print(k,dict(Counter(r[k] for r in rs)))
print('Errors:',Counter(e for r in rs for e in r['errors']).most_common())
